title: Sigma Lithium unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had a working capital deficiency of $171,139.
summary: The Q2 statements show improved first-half operating cash flow but a larger working-capital deficit, limited unrestricted cash, high current debt and supplier balances, related-party exposures, and substantial going-concern uncertainty.
